description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ClientChargeNotFoundException' used within the Fineract project to signal that a client charge with a specific identifier does not exist. It extends a base exception class and provides constructors for different scenarios, including a version that accepts a Spring Data 'EmptyResultDataAccessException'.

classes.name: ClientChargeNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a client charge with a given ID (and optionally a client ID) was not found. It extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: ClientChargeNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a charge ID and constructs an exception message indicating the charge does not exist.

methods.name: ClientChargeNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a charge ID and a client ID, indicating the charge does not exist for the specific client.

methods.name: ClientChargeNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a charge ID, a client ID, and an 'EmptyResultDataAccessException', for wrapping lower-level data access exceptions.
